dedupe_keys.name: global energy virtual water trade network and electricity footprints

description: This global database estimates the water footprint of country-to-country trade in eleven energy commodities during 2010–2018. Researchers at the Air Force Institute of Technology and University of Canterbury publish the origin country, trade partner, commodity, quantity, trade value, mean virtual-water footprint and an estimated uncertainty range. They also provide country electricity-water intensity values. Zenodo supplies four ZIP packages containing electricity inputs, other water-footprint inputs, calculation scripts and final data, under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The resource can parameterize water constraints and cross-border dependencies in coupled energy-system simulations, complementing network-focused data such as data-re-europe. A caveat is that virtual-water estimates attribute upstream water requirements, not measuring physical water shipments between countries. Commodity-specific coefficients and trade coverage influence the result, and the archive's internal formats were not verified by downloading it. The deposited scripts were identified from the file inventory but were not executed, and their compatibility with current source APIs remains untested.
